Use case: stylized-concept.
Create the matching DIAGONAL sheet of an eight-view 360-degree turnaround for HAVENLINE CHARACTER 2. Input image1 is this character's independently PASSED new-style CARDINAL sheet: it is the exact design, adult body proportion, face, hair, outfit, pack, equipment, rendering, scale, studio and typography anchor for this sheet. Input image2 is the user's authoritative polished style reference. Input image3 is this character's original approved identity/gear reference for continuity. Do not redesign, change age or change clothing. Do not copy the man's identity in input image2. Reproduce the exact mature stylized woman from input image1, at the same roughly 5.4-head body proportions, polished skin/cloth/shearling/leather, neutral lighting and light-gray studio.

This is CHARACTER 2: the warm medium-skinned adult woman from input image3, brown eyes, straight dark chin-length bob with a broad side-swept fringe, brown rectangular glasses, clean face with NO beard. Preserve her blue hood worn UP around the hair with thick cream shearling edging, gray neck scarf, closed blue coat with orange shoulder accents and orange front/hem piping, cream wrist cuffs, charcoal FULL FINGERED gloves, navy cargo trousers with knee pads, cream lower-leg cuffs, and brown lace-up capped boots. Keep the brown belt with silver buckle and brown chest/shoulder harness. One brown backpack, one light-BLUE horizontal cylindrical bedroll across its top, original pale side attachments and stitched brown pouches. The brown utility pouch is fixed on her anatomical RIGHT hip; the single silver cup is on her anatomical LEFT side. Front view: pouch is viewer-left and cup viewer-right; rear view: these sides reverse naturally. No extra bags or rolls.

Create one high-resolution square 2048x2048 sheet in a TWO-COLUMN by TWO-ROW layout, exactly FOUR complete whole-body views at the SAME SIZE and consistent camera height as the supplied cardinal sheet. Small charcoal heading exactly "HAVENLINE | CHARACTER 2", subtitle exactly "DIAGONAL VIEWS". Same minimal dark-gray captions and soft ground-contact shadows. No borders, navy background, snow, scene, decorative props or extra people. Generous blank padding around every fingertip, boot and hair; never crop a hand or boot.

TOP-LEFT: FRONT LEFT 45-degree view, the whole body halfway between FRONT and its LEFT profile. Face and torso point diagonally toward image LEFT, with front and anatomical left side visible. Caption "FRONT LEFT · 45°".
TOP-RIGHT: REAR LEFT 135-degree view, the whole body halfway between LEFT profile and BACK. Torso and head face diagonally AWAY toward image LEFT, showing the back of the pack and anatomical left side, not a front-facing head. Caption "REAR LEFT · 135°".
BOTTOM-LEFT: REAR RIGHT 225-degree view, the whole body halfway between BACK and RIGHT profile. Torso and head face diagonally AWAY toward image RIGHT, showing the back of the pack and anatomical right side. Caption "REAR RIGHT · 225°".
BOTTOM-RIGHT: FRONT RIGHT 315-degree view, the whole body halfway between RIGHT profile and FRONT. Face and torso point diagonally toward image RIGHT, showing front and anatomical right side. Caption "FRONT RIGHT · 315°".

Every panel is a true rotation of the SAME whole character and equipment, not a duplicated/mirrored figure. Keep the exact neutral level T-POSE in world space: two arms extended laterally at shoulder height, palms DOWN, fingers naturally extended, both boots flat and feet at hip width. Rotate head with body, never looking separately toward camera. Perspective naturally foreshortens the far arm and hand but does not lower the arms or place them in front of the chest. Every visible hand has FOUR anatomically coherent fingers and ONE thumb, natural ordinary occlusion allowed, no fused/extra digits, no mitten shapes, no detached gloves. Keep every accessory on its original anatomical side in all rotations. Maintain exact facial identity, glasses/headband/earring configuration, hair, coat opening, pocket placement, pack silhouette and roll color from the passed cardinal sheet. Rear views must show the true back of garments and pack, never frontal zipper/vest duplicated on the back. These are STATIC turnaround references, not motion frames or proof of a native mesh or rig.
